snippet.title: Can she change her fate? Spears & Spirits Teaser 2026
snippet.description:
If you enjoy tactical RPGs, turn-based RPGs, deck-building games, narrative RPGs, and indie RPGs with strong atmosphere, Spears & Spirits is a journey worth following.

Spears & Spirits is a story-driven tactical RPG inspired by the myths and cultures of the North. Follow Erumi, a young shamaness marked by prophecy, as she journeys through a harsh Arctic wilderness filled with spirits, legends, and impossible choices.

Experience a unique blend of turn-based tactical combat and deck-building gameplay, where every battle tests your strategy, your resources, and your will to survive. Manage your party carefully, recover from injuries, and make difficult decisions that shape both the story and your relationships with your companions.
